主要内容: Biohaven Pharmaceutical Holding Company Ltd. (BHVN) issued a corrected earnings report on May 10, 2021, with no impact on net product revenue or gross profit. Net product revenue reached $43.8 million in Q1 2021, up from $1.2 million in Q, driven by full-quarter sales of NURTEC ODT. Total expenses rose to $159.5 million, up from $95.6 million in 2020, due to increased commercial spending. The company reported a net loss of $265.0 million, or $4.27 per share, compared to $172.9 million, or $3.07 per share, in 2020. R&D expenses increased to $107.1 million, reflecting later-stage trials for zavegepant. BHV-1200 advanced into clinical development, targeting SARS-CoV-2 variants. The company also plans to report topline data for intranasal zavegepant, verdiperstat, and troriluzole in 2021 and 2022. NURTEC ODT commercialization continued, with potential expansion to migraine prevention in 2021 if FDA approval is granted.
